_readme: Avoidance zones. Copy to zones.json (gitignored) or point AVOID_ZONES_FILE at it.
SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. A routing exclusion is a claim that a driver should
not be sent somewhere, so every zone must cite why. `reason` is required and
`legal-restriction` additionally requires `authority` — the order or statute
that makes entry unlawful. Zones failing validation are rejected at boot with
a log line, not silently dropped.
legal-restriction  entry prohibited by law or military order. In Israel the
usual case is Area A of the West Bank, which Israeli
citizens may not enter; boundaries are published and
signposted, which is what makes them mappable.
hazard             an official advisory: flood, fire, landslide.
Source polygons from an official designation, not from demographics. The
authority field is what keeps this dataset auditable a year from now.
